# NEW 2026-11-17 Roman Reconquest umbrella situation. Generated by gen_rome_reconquista.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# BYZ scope. Starts (or rekindles) the situation. Rekindle passes hope = 25.
oe_rr_start = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = { has_variable = oe_rr_active }
            NOT = { has_variable = oe_rr_broken }
            NOT = { has_global_variable = rome_reconquista_is_end }
        }
        set_variable = oe_rr_active
        set_variable = { name = oe_rr_hope value = $hope$ }
        set_variable = { name = oe_rr_idle_months value = 0 }
        set_variable = { name = oe_rr_idle_tick value = 0 }
        set_variable = { name = oe_rr_long_tick value = 0 }
        oe_rr_recount = yes
        oe_rr_update_tier = yes
        if = { limit = { NOT = { is_situation_active = situation:rome_reconquista } } activate_situation = situation:rome_reconquista }
        trigger_event_non_silently = oe_rr.1
    }
}

# BYZ scope. Recounts restored regions and grants any stage reward not yet given.
oe_rr_recount = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_rr_count value = 0 }
    if = { limit = { oe_rr_region_egypt_done = yes } change_variable = { name = oe_rr_count add = 1 } set_variable = oe_rr_done_egypt }
    if = { limit = { oe_rr_region_africa_done = yes } change_variable = { name = oe_rr_count add = 1 } set_variable = oe_rr_done_africa }
    if = { limit = { oe_rr_region_italy_done = yes } change_variable = { name = oe_rr_count add = 1 } set_variable = oe_rr_done_italy }
    if = { limit = { oe_rr_region_france_done = yes } change_variable = { name = oe_rr_count add = 1 } set_variable = oe_rr_done_france }
    if = { limit = { oe_rr_region_iberia_done = yes } change_variable = { name = oe_rr_count add = 1 } set_variable = oe_rr_done_iberia }
    if = { limit = { oe_rr_region_britain_done = yes } change_variable = { name = oe_rr_count add = 1 } set_variable = oe_rr_done_britain }
    if = { limit = { oe_rr_region_germany_done = yes } change_variable = { name = oe_rr_count add = 1 } set_variable = oe_rr_done_germany }
    if = { limit = { oe_rr_region_persia_done = yes } change_variable = { name = oe_rr_count add = 1 } set_variable = oe_rr_done_persia }
    if = { limit = { oe_rr_region_blacksea_done = yes } change_variable = { name = oe_rr_count add = 1 } set_variable = oe_rr_done_blacksea }
    if = { limit = { oe_rr_region_arabia_done = yes } change_variable = { name = oe_rr_count add = 1 } set_variable = oe_rr_done_arabia }
    if = {
        limit = { has_variable = oe_rr_active var:oe_rr_count >= 3 NOT = { has_variable = oe_rr_stage_3 } }
        set_variable = oe_rr_stage_3
        trigger_event_non_silently = oe_rr.20
    }
    if = {
        limit = { has_variable = oe_rr_active var:oe_rr_count >= 6 NOT = { has_variable = oe_rr_stage_6 } }
        set_variable = oe_rr_stage_6
        trigger_event_non_silently = oe_rr.21
    }
    if = {
        limit = { has_variable = oe_rr_active var:oe_rr_count >= 10 NOT = { has_variable = oe_rr_stage_10 } }
        set_variable = oe_rr_stage_10
        trigger_event_non_silently = oe_rr.22
    }
}

# BYZ scope. Fervour change; no effect while the situation is not running.
oe_rr_add_hope = {
    if = {
        limit = { has_variable = oe_rr_active }
        change_variable = { name = oe_rr_hope add = $amount$ }
        clamp_variable = { name = oe_rr_hope min = 0 max = 100 }
        oe_rr_update_tier = yes
        if = { limit = { var:oe_rr_hope <= 0 } oe_rr_fail = yes }
    }
}

# BYZ scope. Hook for campaign endings and the Germany settlement; outcome-specific fervour is added by the caller.
oe_rr_region_restored = {
    oe_rr_recount = yes
}

oe_rr_update_tier = {
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_rr_hope var:oe_rr_hope <= 24 } set_variable = { name = oe_rr_tier value = 1 } }
    else_if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_rr_hope var:oe_rr_hope <= 59 } set_variable = { name = oe_rr_tier value = 2 } }
    else_if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_rr_hope var:oe_rr_hope <= 84 } set_variable = { name = oe_rr_tier value = 3 } }
    else_if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_rr_hope var:oe_rr_hope <= 100 } set_variable = { name = oe_rr_tier value = 4 } }
    remove_country_modifier = oe_rr_tier_1
    remove_country_modifier = oe_rr_tier_3
    remove_country_modifier = oe_rr_tier_4
    if = { limit = { var:oe_rr_tier ?= 1 } add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_rr_tier_1 years = -1 mode = replace } }
    if = { limit = { var:oe_rr_tier ?= 3 } add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_rr_tier_3 years = -1 mode = replace } }
    if = { limit = { var:oe_rr_tier ?= 4 } add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_rr_tier_4 years = -1 mode = replace } }
}

# BYZ scope. Fervour reached zero: the dream is broken.
oe_rr_fail = {
    remove_variable = oe_rr_active
    set_variable = oe_rr_broken
    set_variable = { name = oe_rr_broken_cd years = 20 }
    remove_variable = oe_rr_rekindle_offered
    remove_country_modifier = oe_rr_tier_1
    remove_country_modifier = oe_rr_tier_3
    remove_country_modifier = oe_rr_tier_4
    add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_rr_dream_broken years = 20 mode = replace }
    trigger_event_non_silently = oe_rr.3
}

# BYZ scope. Monthly while the situation runs (from monthly_country_pulse).
oe_rr_monthly = {
    # 热情消退：连续 5 年没有进行中的征伐，此后每年 -2
    if = {
        limit = { OR = { has_variable = oe_hc_egypt_active has_variable = oe_hc_africa_active has_variable = oe_hc_italy_active has_variable = oe_hc_france_active has_variable = oe_hc_iberia_active has_variable = oe_hc_britain_active has_variable = oe_hc_persia_active has_variable = oe_hc_blacksea_active has_variable = oe_hc_arabia_active } }
        set_variable = { name = oe_rr_idle_months value = 0 }
        set_variable = { name = oe_rr_idle_tick value = 0 }
    }
    else = {
        change_variable = { name = oe_rr_idle_months add = 1 }
        if = {
            limit = { var:oe_rr_idle_months > 60 }
            change_variable = { name = oe_rr_idle_tick add = 1 }
            if = { limit = { var:oe_rr_idle_tick >= 12 } set_variable = { name = oe_rr_idle_tick value = 0 } oe_rr_add_hope = { amount = -2 } }
        }
    }
    # 久战厌倦：一场征伐满 3 年后每年 -3
    if = {
        limit = { OR = { AND = { has_variable = oe_hc_egypt_active var:oe_hc_egypt_months >= 36 } AND = { has_variable = oe_hc_africa_active var:oe_hc_africa_months >= 36 } AND = { has_variable = oe_hc_italy_active var:oe_hc_italy_months >= 36 } AND = { has_variable = oe_hc_france_active var:oe_hc_france_months >= 36 } AND = { has_variable = oe_hc_iberia_active var:oe_hc_iberia_months >= 36 } AND = { has_variable = oe_hc_britain_active var:oe_hc_britain_months >= 36 } AND = { has_variable = oe_hc_persia_active var:oe_hc_persia_months >= 36 } AND = { has_variable = oe_hc_blacksea_active var:oe_hc_blacksea_months >= 36 } AND = { has_variable = oe_hc_arabia_active var:oe_hc_arabia_months >= 36 } } }
        change_variable = { name = oe_rr_long_tick add = 1 }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_rr_long_tick >= 12 } set_variable = { name = oe_rr_long_tick value = 0 } oe_rr_add_hope = { amount = -3 } }
    }
    else = { set_variable = { name = oe_rr_long_tick value = 0 } }
    # 光复十城：帝国集团拥有满 12 个月
    if = {
        limit = { has_variable = oe_rr_active NOT = { has_variable = oe_rr_city_rome } }
        if = {
            limit = { location:rome = { owner ?= { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } } }
            if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_rr_city_rome_m } } set_variable = { name = oe_rr_city_rome_m value = 0 } }
            change_variable = { name = oe_rr_city_rome_m add = 1 }
            if = {
                limit = { var:oe_rr_city_rome_m >= 12 }
                set_variable = oe_rr_city_rome
                remove_variable = oe_rr_city_rome_m
                location:rome = { save_scope_as = target_location }
                trigger_event_non_silently = oe_rr.30
            }
        }
        else = { set_variable = { name = oe_rr_city_rome_m value = 0 } }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { has_variable = oe_rr_active NOT = { has_variable = oe_rr_city_tunis } }
        if = {
            limit = { location:tunis = { owner ?= { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } } }
            if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_rr_city_tunis_m } } set_variable = { name = oe_rr_city_tunis_m value = 0 } }
            change_variable = { name = oe_rr_city_tunis_m add = 1 }
            if = {
                limit = { var:oe_rr_city_tunis_m >= 12 }
                set_variable = oe_rr_city_tunis
                remove_variable = oe_rr_city_tunis_m
                location:tunis = { save_scope_as = target_location }
                trigger_event_non_silently = oe_rr.31
            }
        }
        else = { set_variable = { name = oe_rr_city_tunis_m value = 0 } }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { has_variable = oe_rr_active NOT = { has_variable = oe_rr_city_alexandria } }
        if = {
            limit = { location:alexandria = { owner ?= { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } } }
            if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_rr_city_alexandria_m } } set_variable = { name = oe_rr_city_alexandria_m value = 0 } }
            change_variable = { name = oe_rr_city_alexandria_m add = 1 }
            if = {
                limit = { var:oe_rr_city_alexandria_m >= 12 }
                set_variable = oe_rr_city_alexandria
                remove_variable = oe_rr_city_alexandria_m
                location:alexandria = { save_scope_as = target_location }
                trigger_event_non_silently = oe_rr.32
            }
        }
        else = { set_variable = { name = oe_rr_city_alexandria_m value = 0 } }
    }
    if = {

            }
        }
        else = { set_variable = { name = oe_rr_city_jerusalem_m value = 0 } }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { has_variable = oe_rr_active NOT = { has_variable = oe_rr_city_sivas } }
        if = {
            limit = { location:sivas = { owner ?= { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } } }
            if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_rr_city_sivas_m } } set_variable = { name = oe_rr_city_sivas_m value = 0 } }
            change_variable = { name = oe_rr_city_sivas_m add = 1 }

    if = {
        limit = { has_variable = oe_rr_active }
        random = {
            chance = 3
            random_list = {
                1 = { trigger = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_rr_cd_4 } } set_variable = { name = oe_rr_cd_4 years = 5 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_rr.4 }
